_about: Not Groq: its free plan allows 8,000 tokens a minute, less than a coding bot's own instructions (free-scout.py, 17 Nov 2026). Free AI providers the free bots can use, read by botyard_home.py (the variable each key is given as), free-scout.py (which of a provider's models cost nothing) and the Setup page (a key box each, with where to get the key). A provider OpenCode knows (models.dev) needs only its key; one it does not know has an `opencode` block, added to every free bot's OpenCode settings. Checked 21 Nov 2026 against each provider's own free-tier page; a free tier can change, and free-limits.py learns each model's real allowance from its runs.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.free: Models whose name ends in :free cost nothing; about 50 requests a day, 1,000 after a one-time $10 top-up.

providers.name: NVIDIA
providers.free: Every hosted model is free to try, about 40 requests a minute.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.free: Gemini Flash models are free on an AI Studio key with no billing set up, with a daily request cap per model.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.free: The free Experiment plan opens every model at a low rate (a phone number is asked at sign-up).

providers.name: SambaNova
providers.free: The free tier opens its hosted models at a low daily cap; no card.

providers.name: Cohere
providers.free: A trial key is free for testing, about 1,000 calls a month.

providers.name: Pollinations
providers.free: Free with no key and no sign-up, one request at a time; a small model, so it takes light work.
